prompt: Add `retry` to src/timing.ts (new file): `retry<T>(operation: (attempt: number) => Promise<T>, options: { retries: number; delayMs: number; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<T>`. It calls operation (attempt numbers start at 1) and, when it rejects, waits delayMs * 2^(attempt-1) and tries again, at most `retries` more times; then it rejects with the last error. If the signal is aborted (before or while waiting), it stops at once and rejects with signal.reason. Add tests.
